text:
The equation for the reaction between hydrogen and oxygen is shown.
2H2(g)  +  O2(g)  →  2H2O(g)
Which statement explains why this is a redox reaction?
A
Both oxidation and reduction take place.
B
Heat energy is released to the surroundings.
C
Hydrogen is a reactant.
D
The reaction can be reversed.

options.label: A
options.text: Both oxidation and reduction take place.

options.label: B
options.text: Heat energy is released to the surroundings.
